arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS transactions_over_500_prepaid FROM transactions t JOIN cards c ON t.card_id = c.id WHERE c.card_type = 'Debit (Prepaid)' AND t.amount_usd_cents > 50000
arguments.explanation: Counts transactions above $500 made on prepaid debit cards, across the whole data period.
assumptions: 'Over $500' means amount_usd_cents strictly greater than 50000 (i.e. more than $500.00).
The count includes all transactions, labelled or not, since the question asks for a count rather than a fraud rate.
The period is the full data range, 2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31.
